search_products.description: Search eBay listings for a query and price range, items located in North America (LH_PrefLoc=3), shipping to the configured ZIP, in the user's conditions (LH_ItemCondition=1500|1000|2000|2010|3000|2020|2030; 7000 For parts only when the query asks for parts). Buy It Now by default (price + shipping lowest first); auction=True searches auctions only, ending soonest first. Read and follow pages until the exact matches end; drop parts/not-working listings unless the query asked for parts.

inputs.auction: True: LH_Auction=1&_sop=1 (ending soonest); each card gives current_bid, bids, time_left, ends

steps: search_via=form (default): bring the bound tab to the front; type_cdp the query into search_box; check the box holds exactly the query and search_submit (#gh-search-btn) is uncovered; CDP-click it.

Wait for a results page whose _nkw is the query; then load it with the filters merged in (LH_BIN, LH_PrefLoc=1, _stpos=ZIP, LH_ItemCondition without 7000, _udlo/_udhi, _sop=15, _ipg=120; eBay's _from/_trksid kept).
Wait for result_card or no_results; stop on CAPTCHA/sign-in.
Read down the page with mouse-wheel flicks (module_kit.read_down) - pacing; all cards are already in the DOM.
Read result_card -> card_item_link id + card text lines; ignore cards after fewer_words_divider and the /itm/123456 placeholder.
Exclude by condition and title (ebay_rules.exclusion_reason).
More pages while a next_page exists and the page still added exact matches: read on to Next, pause, CDP-click it (evidence _pgn=N), else open its href.
search_via=url: navigate straight to the filtered search URL and scroll by script (background tab).
search_products.evidence: Every kept item has an item id and a price parsed from its card; the page's results_count was read; excluded items are listed with their reason.
search_products.retry: a page that does not load is reloaded once; a CAPTCHA stops the run

sold_comps.description: Search sold + completed listings for a query to get the real recent market price (median and middle range).
steps: Same as search_products with LH_Sold=1&LH_Complete=1 instead of LH_BIN.
sold_comps.evidence: Items carry a 'Sold <date>' line and a price.

read_listing.description: Open one listing, extract price/shipping to ZIP/condition/returns/seller/specifics/photos, read the seller's description frame, and score trust.
steps: Navigate to /itm/<id>; wait for item_title; highlight the price.
Read item_title, price_primary, bin_price/bid_price, condition, quantity, seller_card, shipping_section, returns_section, item_specifics/spec_pair, photos, store_info, seller_ratings; screenshot.
Check the page's 'eBay item number' equals the requested id.
Open description_frame's src (itm.ebaydesc.com) and read its text.
assess_listing: landed cost, exclusion, description risk phrases, testing evidence, trust score.
read_listing.evidence: Page item number == requested id; title and price read; evidence JSON + screenshot saved with timestamp and sha256.
read_listing.retry: reload once; never clicks anything on the item page

confirm_option.description: On a multi-option listing, select the chosen options in the page and confirm the displayed price equals the embedded-data price. Never clicks Buy It Now / Add to cart.
steps: Open /itm/<id>; wait for msku_panel.

For each chosen option: CDP-click the msku_menu_button whose label is the menu name; wait for its listbox; CDP-click the msku_option whose data-sku-value-name equals the value; wait until the button shows the value.
Read price_primary and compare with the embedded price.
confirm_option.evidence: Every menu button shows the chosen value and price_primary equals the embedded-data price (within $0.01); screenshot saved.
confirm_option.retry: one retry per menu; a mismatch is reported, never 'fixed'

watch_products.description: Poll saved queries (watches/<name>.json) every interval_minutes (>= 5), newest listings first; alert with sound + Windows notification on NEW matching listings and PRICE DROPS; keep each item's price/condition history and mark items that disappear.

inputs.watch: watches/<name>.json: queries with query, min/max, max_price, require/reject, conditions, min_feedback

steps: Preflight once; work in a dedicated tab.
Each cycle: search_products(sort=10 newly listed, 1 page) per query.
diff() against state.json: first cycle is a baseline (no alerts); later cycles alert on new matches under max_price and price drops; listings no longer on the first page get gone_since.
Write state.json and alerts.jsonl; play the alert; show it in the page overlay.
Sleep interval_minutes; reconnect with backoff if the browser drops; stop and alert on CAPTCHA.
watch_products.evidence: alerts.jsonl entry with item id, URL, price, condition, seller; state.json history per item.
watch_products.retry: a dropped session reconnects with backoff (60 s doubling to 15 min); CAPTCHA stops the loop
watch_products.cli: python ebay_watch.py watches/gpus.json  (--once for one cycle, --test-alert)

read_auction.description: Open an auction listing (read-only) and read the current bid, bid count, time left / end time and watchers. Watchers are shown only on the listing page ('108 people are watching this.'); without that signal the count is unknown, not 0.

inputs.item_id: eBay item number of an auction

steps: Human pause, then navigate the bound tab to https://www.ebay.com/itm/<id>; wait for item_title.
Glance down with 1-3 wheel flicks (form mode).
Read bid_price, bid_count, end_time, watchers_signal and the page's 'eBay item number'.
NEVER touch place_bid_button or Watch: presence only.
read_auction.evidence: The page's item number equals the requested id (else an error); bid_count and end_time are read.
